LanguageData.AA_WyrmGrew: {0} has shed its old skin overnight. As {1} has grown in the art, so has the wyrm bound to {MAGE_objective}: it is a {2} now, larger, stronger and harder to kill, and its fire burns hotter.\n\nA wyrm's strength follows its mage's level, and it grows again when {MAGE_pronoun} reaches a new circle.
LanguageData.AA_WyrmBreed: {0} has taken the colours of a {1}.
LanguageData.AA_WyrmDied: {0}, the wyrm bonded to {1}, has died. {MAGE_pronoun} felt it go.\n\nThe bond is broken. A new egg can be hatched in time, but it will not be the same wyrm.
LanguageData.AA_WyrmHatched: The egg cracked in {1}'s hands and {0} climbed out, already hungry. It is small for now. It will follow {MAGE_objective}, fight for {MAGE_objective}, and grow as {MAGE_pronoun} does: a drake at the second circle and a great wyrm at the fourth.\n\nIt is a colony animal like any other. It eats meat, it can be trained and it can haul. Most of {1}'s spells are cast through it, so keep it close and keep it alive.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_WyrmHatch: Hatches your bonded wyrm. It grows with your circle and its strength follows your level. You can only have one.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_Wyrm_Attack: Your wyrm drops what it is doing and attacks the target
LanguageData.AA_Desc_Wyrm_Recall: Your wyrm flies to your side from anywhere on the map
LanguageData.AA_Desc_Wyrm_Devour: Your wyrm eats the corpse whole: it heals {0} per point of body size and its hunger is sated. It will not eat your own people.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_Wyrm_Swap: You and your wyrm trade places
LanguageData.AA_Desc_Wyrm_Ride: You ride your wyrm through the air to the target point. Walls do not stop you.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_Wyrm_Strafe: You ride your wyrm in a straight pass to the target point. Everything under its flight path is hit:
LanguageData.AA_Desc_Wyrm_Empower: Needs your wyrm on the map
LanguageData.AA_Desc_BroodPounce: Every drakeling leaps to the target point and lands for {0} damage on enemies within a cell
LanguageData.AA_Desc_BroodCull: Your wyrm eats every drakeling you have. It heals {0} for each and gains a stack of {1}.
LanguageData.AA_BroodHunted: The brood has marked {0} wild animals and gone after them.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_WyrmHunt: Your wyrm and brood hunt up to {0} wild animals of body size {1} or less, and the kills are marked for hauling
LanguageData.AA_NoTreasure: The wyrm sniffs the air and finds nothing worth digging for.
LanguageData.AA_TreasureFound: The wyrm has scented {0} veins of something valuable.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_WyrmProspect: Reveals the {0} most valuable hidden ore veins on the map and marks them for mining
LanguageData.AA_Desc_WyrmBrooding: Eggs in range come {0} closer to hatching, and pregnant animals as much closer to birth
LanguageData.AA_Desc_WyrmWealth: +{0} spell power per 100,000 colony wealth, up to +{1}
LanguageData.AA_P_WyrmHoard: +{0} spell power for every 100,000 of colony wealth, up to +{1}.
LanguageData.AA_HoardInspect: Next tribute in {0}. The richer the colony, the more it gives.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarKindle: Hangs a {0} at the target point for {1}. You can hold {2} at once; the oldest burns out to make room. Your other spells work through your stars.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarTriangle: Kindles three {0}s in a triangle around the target point for {1}. You can hold {2} at once.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarWeb: Draws lines of light between every pair of your stars within {0} cells of each other. Everything on a line is hit:
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarWebInside: Three linked stars close a triangle. Everything inside one is also hit:
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarWebLinger: The lines stay lit for {0}, striking again at {1} strength
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarWebWall: Each line hardens into a {0} for {1}
LanguageData.AA_Desc_AtStars: At each of your stars, within {0} cells:
LanguageData.AA_Desc_AtStarsSpent: Each of your stars burns out, and within {0} cells of each:
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarShoot: Your nearest star tears loose and flies to the target point, then hangs there. +{0} damage for every star you hold.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarShootAll: Every star you hold flies to the target point at once. +{0} damage for every star you hold.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarStep: You step into the star nearest the target point and out of the light there
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarStepFlare: The star flares as you arrive, within {0} cells:
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarVolley: Every star within {0} cells of the target fires on it:
LanguageData.AA_Desc_StarPulsar: For {0}, each of your stars sweeps a beam {1} cells long in a slow circle. Whatever a beam crosses:
LanguageData.AA_Desc_TurnMoon: Turns your own moon to the next phase for {0}. The sky does not change; your spells do.
LanguageData.AA_P_StarcallerMoon: You carry the phase of the moon. It turns with the days of the quadrum: new, waxing, full, waning. Your lunar spells change with it.
LanguageData.AA_P_StarcallerNight: +{0} spell power at night, and +{1} more under open sky.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_Crescent: A crescent of moonlight flies out to the target point and comes back to your hand. On the way out:
LanguageData.AA_Desc_SignExclusive: You can stand under one sign at a time. Taking this one ends the last.
LanguageData.AA_Desc_Horoscope: Reads each ally's birth sign from the day of the year they were born, and gives them its blessing for {0}
LanguageData.AA_Desc_ShareSign: Allies in range take up the sign you are standing under for {0}
